# ChannelVolume <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Audio](BlitzBasic-Audio)

</div>


```blitzbasic
ChannelVolume:Void channel:Int32, volume:Float32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `channel` | In | Int32 | required | A channel handle from [PlaySound](PlaySound) or [PlayMusic](PlayMusic). |
| `volume` | In | Float32 | required | 0 is silence and 1 is the full volume of the sound. Values outside that range are limited to it. |

## Description

Sets the volume of one channel. It can be changed while the sound plays, for example to fade it out.

## Differences

* A debug build (`-d`) stops the program when the channel was never given out. A channel that is over is fine everywhere, see [Debug handle checks](Debug-Handle-Checks).

## Examples

```blitzbasic
; MakeBeep writes beep.wav, see the LoadSound example for the code.
Local snd = LoadSound("beep.wav")
LoopSound snd
Local ch = PlaySound(snd)
For i = 10 To 0 Step -1
	ChannelVolume ch, i / 10.0
	Delay 150
Next
StopChannel ch
```
